description: This is a newly discovered POKéMON. It is
currently under investigation. No detailed
information is available at this time.

SPECIES_BULBASAUR.name: BULBASAUR
description: There is a plant seed on its back right
from the day this POKéMON is born.
The seed slowly grows larger.

SPECIES_IVYSAUR.name: IVYSAUR
description: There is a plant bulb on its back.
When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said
to blossom into a large flower.

SPECIES_VENUSAUR.name: VENUSAUR
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.
The fragrance becalms those engaged in
a battle.

SPECIES_CHARMANDER.name: CHARMANDER
description: From the time it is born, a flame burns
at the tip of its tail. Its life would end
if the flame were to go out.

SPECIES_CHARMELEON.name: CHARMELEON
description: It lashes about with its tail to knock
down its foe. It then tears up the fallen
opponent with sharp claws.

SPECIES_CHARIZARD.name: CHARIZARD
description: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to
an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out
fire at very high temperatures.

SPECIES_SQUIRTLE.name: SQUIRTLE
description: When it retracts its long neck into its
shell, it squirts out water with vigorous
force.

SPECIES_WARTORTLE.name: WARTORTLE
description: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet.
Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its
longevity.

SPECIES_BLASTOISE.name: BLASTOISE
description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body
to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will
withdraw inside its shell.

SPECIES_CATERPIE.name: CATERPIE
description: It is covered with a green skin. When it
grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself
with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

SPECIES_METAPOD.name: METAPOD
description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy
shell, the body inside is tender.
It can't withstand a harsh attack.

SPECIES_BUTTERFREE.name: BUTTERFREE
description: The wings are protected by rain-repellent
dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly
about even in rain.

SPECIES_WEEDLE.name: WEEDLE
description: Often found in forests and grasslands.
It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two
inches on top of its head.

SPECIES_KAKUNA.name: KAKUNA
description: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage
while making its body. It is almost
completely unable to move on its own.

SPECIES_BEEDRILL.name: BEEDRILL
description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent
speeds, all the while stabbing with the
toxic stinger on its rear.

SPECIES_PIDGEY.name: PIDGEY
description: Does not like to fight. It hides in
tall grass and so on, foraging for food
such as small bugs.

SPECIES_PIDGEOTTO.name: PIDGEOTTO
description: The claws on its feet are well developed.
It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE
to its nest over 60 miles away.

SPECIES_PIDGEOT.name: PIDGEOT
description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to
intimidate enemies. It races through the
skies at Mach-2 speed.

SPECIES_RATTATA.name: RATTATA
description: Its fangs are long and very sharp.
They grow continuously, so it gnaws on
hard things to whittle them down.

SPECIES_RATICATE.name: RATICATE
description: Its rear feet have three toes each.
They are webbed, enabling it to swim
across rivers.

SPECIES_SPEAROW.name: SPEAROW
description: It busily flits around here and there.
Even if it is frail, it can be a tough
foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.

SPECIES_FEAROW.name: FEAROW
description: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it
aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a
whole day without landing.

SPECIES_EKANS.name: EKANS
description: A very common sight in grassland, etc.
It flicks its tongue in and out to sense
danger in its surroundings.

SPECIES_ARBOK.name: ARBOK
description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a
frightening face. Weak foes will flee just
at the sight of the pattern.

SPECIES_PIKACHU.name: PIKACHU
description: It has small electric sacs on both its
cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric
charges from the sacs.

SPECIES_RAICHU.name: RAICHU
description: Its electric charges can reach even
100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause
even an Indian elephant to faint.

SPECIES_SANDSHREW.name: SANDSHREW
description: It burrows and lives underground.
If threatened, it curls itself up into a
ball for protection.

SPECIES_SANDSLASH.name: SANDSLASH
description: It is adept at attacking with the spines
on its back and its sharp claws while
quickly scurrying about.

SPECIES_NIDORAN_F.name: NIDORAN♀
description: Though small, it must be treated with
caution because of its powerfully toxic
barbs. The female has smaller horns.

SPECIES_NIDORINA.name: NIDORINA
description: The female has a gentle temperament.
It emits ultrasonic cries that have the
power to befuddle foes.

SPECIES_NIDOQUEEN.name: NIDOQUEEN
description: The body is covered by stiff, needle-
like scales. If it becomes excited,
the needles bristle outwards.

SPECIES_NIDORAN_M.name: NIDORAN♂
description: Its large ears are flapped like wings
when it is listening to distant sounds.
It extends toxic barbs when angered.

SPECIES_NIDORINO.name: NIDORINO
description: It is easily angered. By swinging its well-
developed horn wildly, it can even punch
through diamond.

SPECIES_NIDOKING.name: NIDOKING
description: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide
and its extended horn. Be careful with
the horn as it contains venom.

SPECIES_CLEFAIRY.name: CLEFAIRY
description: Its adorable appearance makes it popular
as a pet. However, it is rare and
difficult to find.

SPECIES_CLEFABLE.name: CLEFABLE
description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can
easily hear a pin being dropped nearly
1,100 yards away.

SPECIES_VULPIX.name: VULPIX
description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails.
When it grows, several new tails are
sprouted.

SPECIES_NINETALES.name: NINETALES
description: It has nine long tails and fur that
gleams gold. It is said to live for
1,000 years.

SPECIES_JIGGLYPUFF.name: JIGGLYPUFF
description: It captivates foes with its huge, round
eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing
a soothing melody.

SPECIES_WIGGLYTUFF.name: WIGGLYTUFF
description: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and
supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur
conveys an image of luxury.

SPECIES_ZUBAT.name: ZUBAT
description: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on
its ultrasonic cries for echo location to
flit about in darkness.

SPECIES_GOLBAT.name: GOLBAT
description: It clamps down on its prey with needle-
sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of
blood in one gulp.

SPECIES_ODDISH.name: ODDISH
description: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.”
At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000
feet on its two roots.

SPECIES_GLOOM.name: GLOOM
description: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor.
The horrid stench can cause fainting at a
distance of 1.25 miles.

SPECIES_VILEPLUME.name: VILEPLUME
description: Its petals are the largest in the world.
It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing
pollen from its petals.

SPECIES_PARAS.name: PARAS
description: Growing out of the bug's back are
mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms
grow with the bug host.

SPECIES_PARASECT.name: PARASECT
description: It scatters toxic spores from the
mushroom cap. In China, the spores are
used as herbal medicine.

SPECIES_VENONAT.name: VENONAT
description: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be
active in darkness. The eyes can also
shoot powerful beams.

SPECIES_VENOMOTH.name: VENOMOTH
description: The wings are covered with dustlike
scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it
looses highly toxic dust.

SPECIES_DIGLETT.name: DIGLETT
description: It burrows through the ground at a
shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in
its wake, making it easy to spot.

SPECIES_DUGTRIO.name: DUGTRIO
description: In battle, it digs through the ground and
strikes the unsuspecting foe from an
unexpected direction.

SPECIES_MEOWTH.name: MEOWTH
description: All it does is sleep during the daytime.
At night, it patrols its territory with its
eyes aglow.

SPECIES_PERSIAN.name: PERSIAN
description: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it
raises its tail straight up. It is a signal
that it is about to pounce and bite.

SPECIES_PSYDUCK.name: PSYDUCK
description: It is constantly wracked by a headache.
When the headache turns intense, it begins
using mysterious powers.

SPECIES_GOLDUCK.name: GOLDUCK
description: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make
it an adept swimmer. It can be seen
swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

SPECIES_MANKEY.name: MANKEY
description: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious
in temperament. When angered, it flies into
an uncontrollable frenzy.

SPECIES_PRIMEAPE.name: PRIMEAPE
description: It is always outrageously furious. If it
gives chase, it will tenaciously track the
target no matter how far.

SPECIES_GROWLITHE.name: GROWLITHE
description: Very friendly and faithful to people.
It will try to repel enemies by barking
and biting.

SPECIES_ARCANINE.name: ARCANINE
description: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese
legends. It is said to race at an
unbelievable speed.

SPECIES_POLIWAG.name: POLIWAG
description: Its slick black skin is thin and damp.
A part of its internal organs can be seen
through the skin as a spiral pattern.

SPECIES_POLIWHIRL.name: POLIWHIRL
description: Its two legs are well developed.
Even though it can live on the ground,
it prefers living in water.

SPECIES_POLIWRATH.name: POLIWRATH
description: An adept swimmer, it knows the front
crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster
than the best human swimmers.

SPECIES_ABRA.name: ABRA
description: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a
variety of extrasensory powers even
while asleep.

SPECIES_KADABRA.name: KADABRA
description: It happened one morning - a boy with
extrasensory powers awoke in bed
transformed into KADABRA.

SPECIES_ALAKAZAM.name: ALAKAZAM
description: It does not like physical attacks very
much. Instead, it freely uses extra-
sensory powers to defeat foes.

SPECIES_MACHOP.name: MACHOP
description: Its whole body is composed of muscles.
Even though it's the size of a human
child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

SPECIES_MACHOKE.name: MACHOKE
description: Its formidable body never gets tired.
It helps people by doing work such as
the moving of heavy goods.

SPECIES_MACHAMP.name: MACHAMP
description: Its four ruggedly developed arms can
launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just
two seconds.

SPECIES_BELLSPROUT.name: BELLSPROUT
description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because
of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of
legendary mandrake plant.

SPECIES_WEEPINBELL.name: WEEPINBELL
description: The leafy parts act as cutters for
slashing foes. It spits a fluid that
dissolves everything.

SPECIES_VICTREEBEL.name: VICTREEBEL
description: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike
aroma. The helpless prey is melted with
a dissolving fluid.

SPECIES_TENTACOOL.name: TENTACOOL
description: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals.
From them, it shoots mysterious
beams of light.

SPECIES_TENTACRUEL.name: TENTACRUEL
description: It has 80 tentacles that move about
freely. They can sting, causing poisoning
and sharp, stabbing pain.

SPECIES_GEODUDE.name: GEODUDE
description: Its round form makes it easy to pick up.
Some people have used them to hurl
at each other in a snowball fight.

SPECIES_GRAVELER.name: GRAVELER
description: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails.
GRAVELER may come rolling down the path
without slowing.

SPECIES_GOLEM.name: GOLEM
description: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as
rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin
once a year to grow larger.

SPECIES_PONYTA.name: PONYTA
description: Its body is light, and its legs are
incredibly powerful. It can clear
Ayers Rock in one leap.

SPECIES_RAPIDASH.name: RAPIDASH
description: It can gallop at a top speed of 150
miles per hour. It can race as fast as a
bullet train while ablaze.

SPECIES_SLOWPOKE.name: SLOWPOKE
description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but
no one knows what it is thinking about.
It is good at fishing with its tail.

SPECIES_SLOWBRO.name: SLOWBRO
description: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea,
its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That
made it evolve into SLOWBRO.

SPECIES_MAGNEMITE.name: MAGNEMITE
description: It moves while constantly hovering.
It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on
from the units at its sides.

SPECIES_MAGNETON.name: MAGNETON
description: A linked cluster formed of several
MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful
magnetic waves at high voltage.

SPECIES_FARFETCHD.name: FARFETCH'D
description: It always walks about with a plant stalk
clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for
building its nest.

SPECIES_DODUO.name: DODUO
description: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered
as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace
of over 60 miles per hour.

SPECIES_DODRIO.name: DODRIO
description: An odd species that is rarely found.
The three heads respectively represent
joy, sadness, and anger.

SPECIES_SEEL.name: SEEL
description: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is
thick and tough. It is active in bitter
cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

SPECIES_DEWGONG.name: DEWGONG
description: Its body is covered with a pure white
fur. The colder the weather, the more
active it becomes.

SPECIES_GRIMER.name: GRIMER
description: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon
transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding
on filthy things.

SPECIES_MUK.name: MUK
description: It is usually undetectable because it
blends in with the ground. Touching it can
cause terrible poisoning.

SPECIES_SHELLDER.name: SHELLDER
description: It is encased in a shell that is harder
than diamond. Inside, however, it is
surprisingly tender.

SPECIES_CLOYSTER.name: CLOYSTER
description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be
shattered, even with a bomb. The shell
opens only when it is attacking.

SPECIES_GASTLY.name: GASTLY
description: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can
topple an Indian elephant by enveloping
the prey in two seconds.

SPECIES_HAUNTER.name: HAUNTER
description: If you get the feeling of being watched
in darkness when nobody is around,
HAUNTER is there.

SPECIES_GENGAR.name: GENGAR
description: It is said to emerge from darkness to
steal the lives of those who become lost
in mountains.

SPECIES_ONIX.name: ONIX
description: It usually lives underground. It searches
for food while boring its way through the
ground at 50 miles per hour.

SPECIES_DROWZEE.name: DROWZEE
description: A descendent of the legendary animal
baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is
skilled at hypnotism.

SPECIES_HYPNO.name: HYPNO
description: It carries a pendulum-like device. There
once was an incident in which it took
away a child it hypnotized.

SPECIES_KRABBY.name: KRABBY
description: It can be found near the sea. The large
pincers grow back if they are torn out of
their sockets.

SPECIES_KINGLER.name: KINGLER
description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-
horsepower strength. However, being so
big, it is unwieldy to move.

SPECIES_VOLTORB.name: VOLTORB
description: A life-form whose identity is unknown.
It is said to SCREECH or suddenly
SELFDESTRUCT.

SPECIES_ELECTRODE.name: ELECTRODE
description: It explodes in response to even minor
stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname
of “The Bomb Ball.”

SPECIES_EXEGGCUTE.name: EXEGGCUTE
description: Even though it appears to be eggs of
some sort, it was discovered to be a life-
form more like plant seeds.

SPECIES_EXEGGUTOR.name: EXEGGUTOR
description: It is called “The Walking Tropical
Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has
a face and a will of its own.

SPECIES_CUBONE.name: CUBONE
description: It wears the skull of its dead mother on
its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is
said to cry loudly.

SPECIES_MAROWAK.name: MAROWAK
description: It is small and was originally very weak.
Its temperament turned ferocious when it
began using bones.

SPECIES_HITMONLEE.name: HITMONLEE
description: The legs freely contract and stretch.
The stretchy legs allow it to hit a
distant foe with a rising kick.

SPECIES_HITMONCHAN.name: HITMONCHAN
description: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this
POKéMON. It throws punches that are
faster than a bullet train.

SPECIES_LICKITUNG.name: LICKITUNG
description: Its tongue is twice the length of its
body. It can be moved like an arm for
grabbing food and attacking.

SPECIES_KOFFING.name: KOFFING
description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by
horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is
nearby.

SPECIES_WEEZING.name: WEEZING
description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result
in two small KOFFING twins becoming
conjoined as a WEEZING.

SPECIES_RHYHORN.name: RHYHORN
description: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON
can shatter even a skyscraper with its
charging TACKLES.

SPECIES_RHYDON.name: RHYDON
description: It begins walking on its hind legs after
evolution. It can punch holes through
boulders with its horn.

SPECIES_CHANSEY.name: CHANSEY
description: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are
apparently rich in nutrients and extremely
delicious.

SPECIES_TANGELA.name: TANGELA
description: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON's
identity in a tangled mass. It entangles
anything that gets close.

SPECIES_KANGASKHAN.name: KANGASKHAN
description: The female raises its offspring in a pouch
on its belly. It is skilled at attacking
using COMET PUNCH.

SPECIES_HORSEA.name: HORSEA
description: It maintains balance using its tail, which
is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink
from its mouth.

SPECIES_SEADRA.name: SEADRA
description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes.
Carelessly trying to touch it could cause
fainting from the spikes.

SPECIES_GOLDEEN.name: GOLDEEN
description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly
developed like muscles. It can swim at a
speed of five knots.

SPECIES_SEAKING.name: SEAKING
description: The horn on its head is sharp like a
drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to
make its nest.

SPECIES_STARYU.name: STARYU
description: It appears in large numbers by seashores.
At night, its central core flashes with a
red light.

SPECIES_STARMIE.name: STARMIE
description: This POKéMON has a geometric body.
Because of its body, the locals suspect
that it is an alien creature.

SPECIES_MR_MIME.name: MR. MIME
description: It is adept at conning people. It is said
to be able to create walls out of thin
air by miming.

SPECIES_SCYTHER.name: SCYTHER
description: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly
sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its
wings to fly.

SPECIES_JYNX.name: JYNX
description: It speaks using a language that sounds
human. Research is under way to determine
what is being said.

SPECIES_ELECTABUZZ.name: ELECTABUZZ
description: It loves to feed on strong electricity.
It occasionally appears around large
power plants and so on.

SPECIES_MAGMAR.name: MAGMAR
description: Found near the mouth of a volcano.
This fire-breather's body temperature is
nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

SPECIES_PINSIR.name: PINSIR
description: Its two long pincer horns are powerful.
Once they grip an enemy, they won't
release until the foe is torn.

SPECIES_TAUROS.name: TAUROS
description: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips
its body repeatedly with its three
long tails.

SPECIES_MAGIKARP.name: MAGIKARP
description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both
power and speed. It is the most weak and
pathetic POKéMON in the world.

SPECIES_GYARADOS.name: GYARADOS
description: It has an extremely aggressive nature.
The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth
totally incinerates all targets.

SPECIES_LAPRAS.name: LAPRAS
description: Its high intelligence enables it to
understand human speech. It likes to ferry
people on its back.

SPECIES_DITTO.name: DITTO
description: It can freely recombine its own cellular
structure to transform into other life-
forms.

SPECIES_EEVEE.name: EEVEE
description: An extremely rare POKéMON that may
evolve in a number of different ways
depending on stimuli.

SPECIES_VAPOREON.name: VAPOREON
description: Its body's cellular structure is similar to
the molecular composition of water.
It can melt invisibly in water.

SPECIES_JOLTEON.name: JOLTEON
description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all
over its body bristles like sharp needles
that pierce foes.

SPECIES_FLAREON.name: FLAREON
description: It has a flame bag inside its body. After
inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of
nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

SPECIES_PORYGON.name: PORYGON
description: Using the most advanced technologies,
scientists finally succeeded in making the
first artificial POKéMON.

SPECIES_OMANYTE.name: OMANYTE
description: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the
primordial sea, it swims by twisting its
10 tentacles about.

SPECIES_OMASTAR.name: OMASTAR
description: Its tentacles are highly developed as if
they are hands and feet. As soon as it
ensnares prey, it bites.

SPECIES_KABUTO.name: KABUTO
description: This POKéMON was regenerated from the
fossil of an ancient creature. It protects
itself with a hard shell.

SPECIES_KABUTOPS.name: KABUTOPS
description: It swims freely through water. It catches
prey with its scythe-like arms and drains
the victim's fluids.

SPECIES_AERODACTYL.name: AERODACTYL
description: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's
genetic matter that was found in amber.
It flies with high-pitched cries.

SPECIES_SNORLAX.name: SNORLAX
description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880
pounds of food every day. When it is done
eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

SPECIES_ARTICUNO.name: ARTICUNO
description: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.
With its long tail trailing behind, its
flying form is magnificent.

SPECIES_ZAPDOS.name: ZAPDOS
description: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.
While it is flying, it makes crackling and
snapping sounds.

SPECIES_MOLTRES.name: MOLTRES
description: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.
Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its
orange wings that seem to be on fire.

SPECIES_DRATINI.name: DRATINI
description: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in
length. It grows larger by repeatedly
shedding skin.

SPECIES_DRAGONAIR.name: DRAGONAIR
description: It is said to live in seas and lakes.
Even though it has no wings, it has been
seen flying occasionally.

SPECIES_DRAGONITE.name: DRAGONITE
description: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky
physique. It circles the globe in just
16 hours.

SPECIES_MEWTWO.name: MEWTWO
description: A POKéMON whose genetic code was
repeatedly recombined for research.
It turned vicious as a result.

SPECIES_MEW.name: MEW
description: A POKéMON of South America that was
thought to have been extinct. It is very
intelligent and learns any move.

SPECIES_CHIKORITA.name: CHIKORITA
description: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the
Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the
ability to check the humidity and
temperature.

SPECIES_BAYLEEF.name: BAYLEEF
description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its
neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to
restore health.

SPECIES_MEGANIUM.name: MEGANIUM
description: MEGANIUM's breath has the power to revive
dead grass and plants. It can make them
healthy again.

SPECIES_CYNDAQUIL.name: CYNDAQUIL
description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is
angry or surprised, it shoots flames out
of its back.

SPECIES_QUILAVA.name: QUILAVA
description: This POKéMON is fully covered by
nonflammable fur. It can withstand any
kind of fire attack.

SPECIES_TYPHLOSION.name: TYPHLOSION
description: It has a secret, devastating move. It
rubs its blazing fur together to cause
huge explosions.

SPECIES_TOTODILE.name: TOTODILE
description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't
hesitate to take a bite out of anything
that moves.

SPECIES_CROCONAW.name: CROCONAW
description: It opens its huge jaws wide when
attacking. If it loses any fangs while
biting, they grow back in.

SPECIES_FERALIGATR.name: FERALIGATR
description: It is hard for it to support its own
weight out of water, so it gets down on
all fours. But it moves fast.

SPECIES_SENTRET.name: SENTRET
description: It stands on its tail so it can see a long
way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly
to warn its kind.

SPECIES_FURRET.name: FURRET
description: There is no telling where its tail begins.
Despite its short legs, it is quick at
hunting RATTATA.

SPECIES_HOOTHOOT.name: HOOTHOOT
description: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever
happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely
tilting its head in time.

SPECIES_NOCTOWL.name: NOCTOWL
description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head
180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual
power.

SPECIES_LEDYBA.name: LEDYBA
description: When the weather turns cold, numerous
LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster
and keep each other warm.

SPECIES_LEDIAN.name: LEDIAN
description: The star patterns on its back grow larger
or smaller depending on the number of
stars in the night sky.

SPECIES_SPINARAK.name: SPINARAK
description: It spins a web using fine--but durable--
thread. It then waits patiently for prey
to be trapped.

SPECIES_ARIADOS.name: ARIADOS
description: A single strand of a special string is
endlessly spun out of its rear. The string
leads back to its nest.

SPECIES_CROBAT.name: CROBAT
description: The development of wings on its legs
enables it to fly fast but also makes it
tough to stop and rest.

SPECIES_CHINCHOU.name: CHINCHOU
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means
of communication is its constantly
flashing lights.

SPECIES_LANTURN.name: LANTURN
description: It blinds prey with an intense burst of
light, then swallows the immobilized prey
in a single gulp.

SPECIES_PICHU.name: PICHU
description: Despite its small size, it can zap even
adult humans. However, if it does so, it
also surprises itself.

SPECIES_CLEFFA.name: CLEFFA
description: When numerous meteors illuminate the
night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely
increase.

SPECIES_IGGLYBUFF.name: IGGLYBUFF
description: Its extremely flexible and elastic body
makes it bounce continuously--anytime,
anywhere.

SPECIES_TOGEPI.name: TOGEPI
description: A proverb claims that happiness will come
to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI
stand up.

SPECIES_TOGETIC.name: TOGETIC
description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind
people. It can float in midair without
moving its wings.

SPECIES_NATU.name: NATU
description: It usually forages for food on the ground
but may, on rare occasions, hop onto
branches to peck at shoots.

SPECIES_XATU.name: XATU
description: In South America, it is said that its right
eye sees the future and its left eye
views the past.

SPECIES_MAREEP.name: MAREEP
description: Its fleece grows continually. In the
summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it
grows back in a week.

SPECIES_FLAAFFY.name: FLAAFFY
description: Its fluffy fleece easily stores
electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it
from being electrocuted.

SPECIES_AMPHAROS.name: AMPHAROS
description: The bright light on its tail can be seen
far away. It has been treasured since
ancient times as a beacon.

SPECIES_BELLOSSOM.name: BELLOSSOM
description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances,
its petals rub together and make a
pleasant ringing sound.

SPECIES_MARILL.name: MARILL
description: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that
keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious
current.

SPECIES_AZUMARILL.name: AZUMARILL
description: When it plays in water, it rolls up its
elongated ears to prevent their insides
from getting wet.

SPECIES_SUDOWOODO.name: SUDOWOODO
description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid
attack. It hates water, so it will
disappear if it starts raining.

SPECIES_POLITOED.name: POLITOED
description: Whenever three or more of these get
together, they sing in a loud voice that
sounds like bellowing.

SPECIES_HOPPIP.name: HOPPIP
description: Its body is so light, it must grip the
ground firmly with its feet to keep from
being blown away.

SPECIES_SKIPLOOM.name: SKIPLOOM
description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight.
It also floats in the air to get closer to
the sun.

SPECIES_JUMPLUFF.name: JUMPLUFF
description: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads
its cotton-like spores all over the world
to make more offspring.

SPECIES_AIPOM.name: AIPOM
description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping
from branch to branch, it deftly uses its
tail for balance.

SPECIES_SUNKERN.name: SUNKERN
description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from
under the leaves of plants. It is said
that it eats nothing else.

SPECIES_SUNFLORA.name: SUNFLORA
description: In the daytime, it rushes about in a
hectic manner, but it comes to a complete
stop when the sun sets.

SPECIES_YANMA.name: YANMA
description: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees.
It looks in all directions to seek out
insects as its prey.

SPECIES_WOOPER.name: WOOPER
description: When it walks around on the ground,
it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous
film.

SPECIES_QUAGSIRE.name: QUAGSIRE
description: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude,
it often bumps its head on boulders and
boat hulls as it swims.

SPECIES_ESPEON.name: ESPEON
description: By reading air currents, it can predict
things such as the weather or its foe's
next move.

SPECIES_UMBREON.name: UMBREON
description: When darkness falls, the rings on its body
begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts
of anyone nearby.

SPECIES_MURKROW.name: MURKROW
description: It is said that when chased, it lures its
attacker onto dark mountain trails where
the foe will get lost.

SPECIES_SLOWKING.name: SLOWKING
description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered
SLOWPOKE's head and unlocked an
extraordinary power.

SPECIES_MISDREAVUS.name: MISDREAVUS
description: It loves to bite and yank people's hair
from behind without warning, just to see
their shocked reactions.

SPECIES_UNOWN.name: UNOWN
description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on
walls. Its shape appears to have some
meaning.

SPECIES_WOBBUFFET.name: WOBBUFFET
description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it
lives quietly in the darkness. It is never
first to attack.

SPECIES_GIRAFARIG.name: GIRAFARIG
description: Its tail, which also contains a small
brain, may bite on its own if it notices an
alluring smell.

SPECIES_PINECO.name: PINECO
description: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey
to come near. It does not move about
much on its own.

SPECIES_FORRETRESS.name: FORRETRESS
description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree.
It scatters pieces of its hard shell to
drive its enemies away.

SPECIES_DUNSPARCE.name: DUNSPARCE
description: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with
its tail. It can hover just slightly using
its wings.

SPECIES_GLIGAR.name: GLIGAR
description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots
its prey, it spreads its wings and glides
down to attack.

SPECIES_STEELIX.name: STEELIX
description: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over
100 years, its composition changes to
become diamond-like.

SPECIES_SNUBBULL.name: SNUBBULL
description: It has an active, playful nature. Many
women like to frolic with it because of
its affectionate ways.

SPECIES_GRANBULL.name: GRANBULL
description: Because its fangs are too heavy, it
always keeps its head tilted down.
However, its BITE is powerful.

SPECIES_QWILFISH.name: QWILFISH
description: The small spikes covering its body
developed from scales. They inject a
toxin that causes fainting.

SPECIES_SCIZOR.name: SCIZOR
description: Its wings are not used for flying.
They are flapped at high speed to adjust
its body temperature.

SPECIES_SHUCKLE.name: SHUCKLE
description: It stores BERRIES inside its shell.
To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks
and remains completely still.

SPECIES_HERACROSS.name: HERACROSS
description: Usually docile, but if disturbed while
sipping honey, it chases off the intruder
with its horn.

SPECIES_SNEASEL.name: SNEASEL
description: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from
their nests and feasts on the eggs that
are left behind.

SPECIES_TEDDIURSA.name: TEDDIURSA
description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime,
its habit is to hoard food in many hidden
locations.

SPECIES_URSARING.name: URSARING
description: With its ability to distinguish any smell,
it unfailingly finds all food buried deep
underground.

SPECIES_SLUGMA.name: SLUGMA
description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it
slowly slithers around in a constant
search for warm places.

SPECIES_MAGCARGO.name: MAGCARGO
description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts
intense flames that circulate throughout
its body.

SPECIES_SWINUB.name: SWINUB
description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes
off headlong to find the source of the
aroma.

SPECIES_PILOSWINE.name: PILOSWINE
description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on
its back stand up straight. It is very
sensitive to sound.

SPECIES_CORSOLA.name: CORSOLA
description: In a south sea nation, the people live in
communities that are built on groups of
these POKéMON.

SPECIES_REMORAID.name: REMORAID
description: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it
clings to a MANTINE's underside to
scavenge for leftovers.

SPECIES_OCTILLERY.name: OCTILLERY
description: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes.
If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a
fellow OCTILLERY.

SPECIES_DELIBIRD.name: DELIBIRD
description: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs.
It spends all day carrying food to its
awaiting chicks.

SPECIES_MANTINE.name: MANTINE
description: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly
out of the water and over the waves if it
builds up enough speed.

SPECIES_SKARMORY.name: SKARMORY
description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings
of its chicks grow hard from scratches by
thorns.

SPECIES_HOUNDOUR.name: HOUNDOUR
description: To corner prey, they check each other's
location using barks that only they can
understand.

SPECIES_HOUNDOOM.name: HOUNDOOM
description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other
POKéMON get the shivers and head straight
back to their nests.

SPECIES_KINGDRA.name: KINGDRA
description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to
build its energy. It is said to cause
tornadoes as it wakes.

SPECIES_PHANPY.name: PHANPY
description: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its
snout. However, it is so strong, it may
send you flying.

SPECIES_DONPHAN.name: DONPHAN
description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the
higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take
a long time to grow.

SPECIES_PORYGON2.name: PORYGON2
description: Further research enhanced its abilities.
Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that
were not programmed.

SPECIES_STANTLER.name: STANTLER
description: Those who stare at its antlers will
gradually lose control of their senses
and be unable to stand.

SPECIES_SMEARGLE.name: SMEARGLE
description: Once it becomes an adult, it has a
tendency to let its comrades plant
footprints on its back.

SPECIES_TYROGUE.name: TYROGUE
description: Even though it is small, it can't be
ignored because it will slug any handy
target without warning.

SPECIES_HITMONTOP.name: HITMONTOP
description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it
spins at high speed, it may bore its way
into the ground.

SPECIES_SMOOCHUM.name: SMOOCHUM
description: It always rocks its head slowly backwards
and forwards as if it is trying to kiss
someone.

SPECIES_ELEKID.name: ELEKID
description: Even in the most vicious storm, this
POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles
in the sky.

SPECIES_MAGBY.name: MAGBY
description: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body
heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit,
so don't underestimate it.

SPECIES_MILTANK.name: MILTANK
description: If it has just had a baby, the milk it
produces contains much more nutrition than
usual.

SPECIES_BLISSEY.name: BLISSEY
description: It has a very compassionate nature. If it
sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the
sufferer back to health.

SPECIES_RAIKOU.name: RAIKOU
description: This POKéMON races across the
land while barking a cry that sounds
like crashing thunder.

SPECIES_ENTEI.name: ENTEI
description: A POKéMON that races across the land.
It is said that one is born every time a
new volcano appears.

SPECIES_SUICUNE.name: SUICUNE
description: This POKéMON races across the land.
It is said that north winds will somehow
blow whenever it appears.

SPECIES_LARVITAR.name: LARVITAR
description: It is born deep underground. It can't
emerge until it has entirely consumed the
soil around it.

SPECIES_PUPITAR.name: PUPITAR
description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move
freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding
destructive power.

SPECIES_TYRANITAR.name: TYRANITAR
description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of
attack, so it is very eager to make
challenges against enemies.It has an impudent nature. Having great
strength, it can even change surrounding
landforms.

SPECIES_LUGIA.name: LUGIA
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas.
It is rumored to have been seen on the
night of a storm.

SPECIES_HO_OH.name: HO-OH
description: A legend says that its body glows in
seven colors. A rainbow is said to form
behind it when it flies.

SPECIES_CELEBI.name: CELEBI
description: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest,
it is said to leave behind an egg it
brought from the future.

SPECIES_RAINER.name: RAINER
description: This POKéMON is simultaneously mortal
and divine, yet none at once. In a
normal world, it should not exist.

SPECIES_SAPUSAUR.name: SAPUSAUR
description: This POKéMON is very docile and
typically don't fight. Because of this,
it is popular with retired trainers.

SPECIES_CHARCOLT.name: CHARCOLT
description: A very aggressive POKéMON that you do
not want to see in the wild. Its white
tail burns things quite easily.

SPECIES_NIHILEGO.name: NIHILEGO
description: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts.
It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon
is sentient, but sometimes it can be
observed behaving like a young girl.

SPECIES_TOGEDEMARU.name: TOGEDEMARU
description: When it's surprised or agitated, the
14 fur spikes on its back will stand
up involuntarily.

SPECIES_INDEEDEE.name: INDEEDEE
description: These intelligent POKéMON touch horns
with each other to share information
between them.
variationDescription: It can pick up on the emotions of
are the source of its strength.

SPECIES_PETILIL.name: PETILIL
description: The leaves on its head grow right back
even if they fall out. These bitter
leaves refresh those who eat them.

SPECIES_LILLIGANT.name: LILLIGANT
description: The fragrance of the garland on its
head has a relaxing effect, but
taking care of it is very difficult.

SPECIES_UNOWN_KING.name: UNOWNKING
description: This POKéMON sleeps for thousands of
years to regain power. Legends say
that it once ruled everything.

SPECIES_TREECKO.name: TREECKO
description: It quickly scales even vertical walls.
It senses humidity with its tail to predict
the next day's weather.

SPECIES_GROVYLE.name: GROVYLE
description: Its strongly developed thigh muscles
give it astounding agility and jumping
performance.

SPECIES_SCEPTILE.name: SCEPTILE
description: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp
as swords. It agilely leaps about the
branches of trees to strike.

SPECIES_TORCHIC.name: TORCHIC
description: It has a flame sac inside its belly that
perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is
hugged.

SPECIES_COMBUSKEN.name: COMBUSKEN
description: It boosts its concentration by emitting
harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding
destructive power.

SPECIES_BLAZIKEN.name: BLAZIKEN
description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames
from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it
jump clear over buildings.

SPECIES_MUDKIP.name: MUDKIP
description: Its large tail fin propels it through
water with powerful acceleration. It is
strong in spite of its size.

SPECIES_MARSHTOMP.name: MARSHTOMP
description: It is at its best when on muddy ground
with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms
foes struggling in mud.

SPECIES_SWAMPERT.name: SWAMPERT
description: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing,
they can batter down its foe. It makes its
nest on beautiful beaches.

SPECIES_POOCHYENA.name: POOCHYENA
description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute
sense of smell lets it chase a chosen
prey without ever losing track.

SPECIES_MIGHTYENA.name: MIGHTYENA
description: It will always obey the commands of a
skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from
its living in packs in ancient times.

SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON.name: ZIGZAGOON
description: A POKéMON with abundant curiosity.
It shows an interest in everything, so it
always zigs and zags.

SPECIES_LINOONE.name: LINOONE
description: When running in a straight line, it can top
60 miles per hour. However, it has a
tough time with curved roads.

SPECIES_WURMPLE.name: WURMPLE
description: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests.
When attacked, it resists by pointing its
venomous spikes at the foe.

SPECIES_SILCOON.name: SILCOON
description: It conserves its energy by moving as
little as possible. It awaits evolution
while drinking only a little rainwater.

SPECIES_BEAUTIFLY.name: BEAUTIFLY
description: Despite its appearance, it has an
aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing
with its long, thin mouth.

SPECIES_CASCOON.name: CASCOON
description: Its body, which is made of soft silk,
hardens over time. When cracks appear,
evolution is near.

SPECIES_DUSTOX.name: DUSTOX
description: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it
senses danger. They tend to gather in the
glow of streetlamps at night.

SPECIES_LOTAD.name: LOTAD
description: It searches about for clean water. If it
does not drink water for too long, the
leaf on its head wilts.

SPECIES_LOMBRE.name: LOMBRE
description: It lives at the water's edge where it is
sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass
by day and becomes active at night.

SPECIES_LUDICOLO.name: LUDICOLO
description: The rhythm of bright, festive music
activates LUDICOLO's cells, making it more
powerful.

SPECIES_SEEDOT.name: SEEDOT
description: If it remains still, it becomes impossible
to distinguish from real nuts. It delights
in surprising foraging PIDGEY.

SPECIES_NUZLEAF.name: NUZLEAF
description: They live in holes bored in large trees.
The sound of NUZLEAF's grass flute fills
listeners with dread.

SPECIES_SHIFTRY.name: SHIFTRY
description: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest
guardian. It can read the foe's mind and
take preemptive action.

SPECIES_NINCADA.name: NINCADA
description: Because it lived almost entirely
underground, it is nearly blind.
It uses its antennae instead.

SPECIES_NINJASK.name: NINJASK
description: This POKéMON is so quick, it is said to
be able to avoid any attack. It loves to
feed on tree sap.

SPECIES_SHEDINJA.name: SHEDINJA
description: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow
appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA
evolves.

SPECIES_TAILLOW.name: TAILLOW
description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to
other lands in search of warmth, flying
over 180 miles a day.

SPECIES_SWELLOW.name: SWELLOW
description: If its two tail feathers are standing at
attention, it is proof of good health.
It soars elegantly in the sky.

SPECIES_SHROOMISH.name: SHROOMISH
description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains
still in the forest shade. It releases
toxic powder from its head.

SPECIES_BRELOOM.name: BRELOOM
description: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic
spores. It knocks out foes with quick,
virtually invisible punches.

SPECIES_SPINDA.name: SPINDA
description: No two SPINDA are said to have identical
patterns. It confuses foes with its
stumbling motions.

SPECIES_WINGULL.name: WINGULL
description: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were
a glider. In the winter, it hides food
around its nest.

SPECIES_PELIPPER.name: PELIPPER
description: It is a flying transporter that carries
small POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the
waves to rest its wings.

SPECIES_SURSKIT.name: SURSKIT
description: They usually live on ponds, but after an
evening shower, they may appear on
puddles in towns.

SPECIES_MASQUERAIN.name: MASQUERAIN
description: The antennae have distinctive patterns
that look like eyes. When it rains, they
grow heavy, making flight impossible.

SPECIES_WAILMER.name: WAILMER
description: When it sucks in a large volume of
seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy
ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

SPECIES_WAILORD.name: WAILORD
description: It is among the largest of all POKéMON.
It herds prey in a pack then swallows the
massed prey in one gulp.

SPECIES_SKITTY.name: SKITTY
description: It is said to be difficult to earn its
trust. However, it is extremely popular
for its cute looks and behavior.

SPECIES_DELCATTY.name: DELCATTY
description: The favorite of trend-conscious
female TRAINERS, they are used in
competition for their style and fur.

SPECIES_KECLEON.name: KECLEON
description: It changes body color to blend in with
its surroundings. It also changes color if
it is happy or sad.

SPECIES_BALTOY.name: BALTOY
description: It was discovered in ancient ruins.
While moving, it constantly spins. It
stands on one foot even when asleep.

SPECIES_CLAYDOL.name: CLAYDOL
description: It appears to have been born from clay
dolls made by ancient people. It uses
telekinesis to float and move.

SPECIES_NOSEPASS.name: NOSEPASS
description: Its magnetic nose consistently faces
north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get
their bearings.

SPECIES_TORKOAL.name: TORKOAL
description: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is
attacked, it belches thick, black smoke
and flees.

SPECIES_SABLEYE.name: SABLEYE
description: It feeds on gemstone crystals.
In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the
glitter of jewels.

SPECIES_BARBOACH.name: BARBOACH
description: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two
long whiskers. A slimy film protects its
body.

SPECIES_WHISCASH.name: WHISCASH
description: It makes its nest at the bottom of
swamps. It will eat anything - if it is
alive, WHISCASH will eat it.

SPECIES_LUVDISC.name: LUVDISC
description: During the spawning season, countless
LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs,
turning the waters pink.

SPECIES_CORPHISH.name: CORPHISH
description: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy
creature that will quickly proliferate,
even in polluted streams.

SPECIES_CRAWDAUNT.name: CRAWDAUNT
description: A rough customer that wildly flails its
giant claws. It is said to be extremely
hard to raise.

SPECIES_FEEBAS.name: FEEBAS
description: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance,
it is ignored by researchers. It lives in
ponds choked with weeds.

SPECIES_MILOTIC.name: MILOTIC
description: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful.
Those that see it are said to forget their
combative spirits.

SPECIES_CARVANHA.name: CARVANHA
description: It lives in massive rivers that course
through jungles. It swarms prey that
enter its territory.

SPECIES_SHARPEDO.name: SHARPEDO
description: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that
crunch through iron. It swims by jetting
water from its rear.

SPECIES_TRAPINCH.name: TRAPINCH
description: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a
sloping pit trap in sand where it
patiently awaits prey.

SPECIES_VIBRAVA.name: VIBRAVA
description: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently
flapping its wings. After making its prey
faint, it melts the prey with acid.

SPECIES_FLYGON.name: FLYGON
description: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand
with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes
from sand.

SPECIES_MAKUHITA.name: MAKUHITA
description: It grows stronger by enduring harsh
training. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can
withstand any attack.

SPECIES_HARIYAMA.name: HARIYAMA
description: It stomps on the ground to build power.
It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a
straight-arm punch.

SPECIES_ELECTRIKE.name: ELECTRIKE
description: It stores static electricity in its fur
for discharging. It gives off sparks if a
storm approaches.

SPECIES_MANECTRIC.name: MANECTRIC
description: It rarely appears before people.
It is said to nest where lightning has
fallen.

SPECIES_NUMEL.name: NUMEL
description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit
courses through its body. When it grows
cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

SPECIES_CAMERUPT.name: CAMERUPT
description: If angered, the humps on its back erupt
in a shower of molten lava. It lives in
the craters of volcanoes.

SPECIES_SPHEAL.name: SPHEAL
description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The
fur keeps it from feeling cold while
it is rolling on ice.

SPECIES_SEALEO.name: SEALEO
description: It touches new things with its nose to
test for smell and feel. It plays by
spinning SPHEAL on its nose.

SPECIES_WALREIN.name: WALREIN
description: It swims through icy seas while shattering
ice floes with its large tusks. It is
protected by its thick blubber.

SPECIES_CACNEA.name: CACNEA
description: It prefers harsh environments such as
deserts. It can survive for 30 days on
water stored in its body.

SPECIES_CACTURNE.name: CACTURNE
description: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at
night when it hunts for prey exhausted
from the desert's heat.

SPECIES_SNORUNT.name: SNORUNT
description: It is said that a home visited by a
SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand
cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

SPECIES_GLALIE.name: GLALIE
description: It has a body of ice that won't melt,
even with fire. It can instantly freeze
moisture in the atmosphere.

SPECIES_LUNATONE.name: LUNATONE
description: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar
cycle. It brims with power when exposed
to the light of the full moon.

SPECIES_SOLROCK.name: SOLROCK
description: It absorbs solar energy during the day.
Always expressionless, it can sense what
its foe is thinking.

SPECIES_AZURILL.name: AZURILL
description: It battles by flinging around its tail,
which is bigger than its body. The
tail is a flotation device in water.

SPECIES_SPOINK.name: SPOINK
description: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing
about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL
on its head.

SPECIES_GRUMPIG.name: GRUMPIG
description: It can gain control over foes by doing
odd dance steps. The black pearls on its
forehead are precious gems.

SPECIES_PLUSLE.name: PLUSLE
description: It cheers on partners while scattering
sparks from its body. It climbs telephone
poles to absorb electricity.

SPECIES_MINUN.name: MINUN
description: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter
under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses
pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

SPECIES_MAWILE.name: MAWILE
description: It uses its docile-looking face to lull
foes into complacency, then bites with its
huge, relentless jaws.

SPECIES_MEDITITE.name: MEDITITE
description: It never skips its daily yoga training.
It heightens its inner strength through
meditation.

SPECIES_MEDICHAM.name: MEDICHAM
description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-
like steps, then launches a devastating
blow in the same motion.

SPECIES_SWABLU.name: SWABLU
description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like
wings. It takes a shower to clean
itself if it becomes dirty.

SPECIES_ALTARIA.name: ALTARIA
description: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling
deep among mountains far from people,
it is ALTARIA's humming.

SPECIES_WYNAUT.name: WYNAUT
description: It tends to move in a pack with others.
They cluster in a tight group to sleep in
a cave.

SPECIES_DUSKULL.name: DUSKULL
description: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks
up to prey. It has the ability to slip
through thick walls.

SPECIES_DUSCLOPS.name: DUSCLOPS
description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens
its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it
were a black hole.

SPECIES_ROSELIA.name: ROSELIA
description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance.
The stronger its aroma, the healthier
the ROSELIA is.

SPECIES_SLAKOTH.name: SLAKOTH
description: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making
drowsy those that see it is one of
its abilities.

SPECIES_VIGOROTH.name: VIGOROTH
description: It is always hungry because it won't stop
rampaging. Even while it is eating, it
can't keep still.

SPECIES_SLAKING.name: SLAKING
description: It is the world's most slothful POKéMON.
However, it can exert horrifying power by
releasing pent-up energy all at once.

SPECIES_GULPIN.name: GULPIN
description: There is nothing its stomach can't digest.
While it is digesting, vile, overpowering
gases are expelled.

SPECIES_SWALOT.name: SWALOT
description: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp.
It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from
the pores on its body.

SPECIES_TROPIUS.name: TROPIUS
description: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of
fruit around its neck is delicious.
The fruit grows twice a year.

SPECIES_WHISMUR.name: WHISMUR
description: It usually murmurs, but starts crying
loudly if it senses danger. It stops when
its ear covers are shut.

SPECIES_LOUDRED.name: LOUDRED
description: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it
generates ultrasonic waves that can blow
apart a house.

SPECIES_EXPLOUD.name: EXPLOUD
description: It emits a variety of sounds from the
holes all over its body. Its loud cries
can be heard from over six miles away.

SPECIES_CLAMPERL.name: CLAMPERL
description: It is protected by a sturdy shell.
Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent
pearl.

SPECIES_HUNTAIL.name: HUNTAIL
description: It lives deep in the sea where no light
ever filters down. It lights up its small
fishlike tail to attract prey.

SPECIES_GOREBYSS.name: GOREBYSS
description: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant.
With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed
that grows between rocks.

SPECIES_ABSOL.name: ABSOL
description: It appears when it senses an impending
natural disaster. As a result, it was
mistaken as a doom-bringer.

SPECIES_SHUPPET.name: SHUPPET
description: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and
malice. Its upright horn catches the
emotions of people.

SPECIES_BANETTE.name: BANETTE
description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet
into a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth,
its cursed energy escapes.

SPECIES_SEVIPER.name: SEVIPER
description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard
rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes
unwary prey with venomous fangs.

SPECIES_ZANGOOSE.name: ZANGOOSE
description: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur
bristles and it assumes its battle pose.
Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

SPECIES_RELICANTH.name: RELICANTH
description: It has remained unchanged for 100
million years. It was discovered
during a deep-sea exploration.

SPECIES_ARON.name: ARON
description: It eats iron to build its steel body.
It is a pest that descends from mountains
to eat bridges and train tracks.

SPECIES_LAIRON.name: LAIRON
description: It habitually shows off its strength with
the size of sparks it creates by ramming
its steel body into boulders.

SPECIES_AGGRON.name: AGGRON
description: It claims a large mountain as its sole
territory. It mercilessly thrashes those
that violate its space.

SPECIES_CASTFORM.name: CASTFORM
description: It has the ability to change its form into
the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud,
depending on the weather.

SPECIES_VOLBEAT.name: VOLBEAT
description: It lives around clean ponds. At night,
its rear lights up. It converses with
others by flashing its light.

SPECIES_ILLUMISE.name: ILLUMISE
description: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night
skies. There are scientists that study the
patterns it creates.

SPECIES_LILEEP.name: LILEEP
description: It became extinct roughly 100 million
years ago. It was regenerated from a
fossil using advanced techniques.

SPECIES_CRADILY.name: CRADILY
description: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles.
It then melts the prey with a strong acid
before feeding.

SPECIES_ANORITH.name: ANORITH
description: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor.
It uses its extending claws to catch prey
hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

SPECIES_ARMALDO.name: ARMALDO
description: Protected by a hard shell, its body is
very sturdy. It skewers prey with its
claws to feed.

SPECIES_RALTS.name: RALTS
description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of
people and POKéMON. It hides if it senses
hostility.

SPECIES_KIRLIA.name: KIRLIA
description: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives
it energy for its psychokinetic power.
It spins and dances when happy.

SPECIES_GARDEVOIR.name: GARDEVOIR
description: It has the power to predict the future.
Its power peaks when it is protecting its
TRAINER.

SPECIES_BAGON.name: BAGON
description: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders.
It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it
can fly.

SPECIES_SHELGON.name: SHELGON
description: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce
off. The armor is too tough, however,
making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

SPECIES_SALAMENCE.name: SALAMENCE
description: It becomes uncontrollable if it is
enraged. It destroys everything with
shredding claws and fire.

SPECIES_BELDUM.name: BELDUM
description: It uses magnetic waves to converse with
its kind. All the cells in its body are
magnetic.

SPECIES_METANG.name: METANG
description: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body
is so tough, even a crash with a jet
plane won't leave a scratch.

SPECIES_METAGROSS.name: METAGROSS
description: It is formed by two METANG fusing.
Its four brains are said to be superior
to a supercomputer.

SPECIES_REGIROCK.name: REGIROCK
description: It is entirely composed of rocks with no
sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery
even to modern scientists.

SPECIES_REGICE.name: REGICE
description: Research revealed that its body is made
of the same kind of ice that is found at
the South Pole.

SPECIES_REGISTEEL.name: REGISTEEL
description: It is sturdier than any kind of metal.
It hardened due to pressure underground
over tens of thousands of years.

SPECIES_KYOGRE.name: KYOGRE
description: This POKéMON is said to have
expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains.
It has the power to control water.

SPECIES_GROUDON.name: GROUDON
description: This legendary POKéMON is said to
represent the land. It went to sleep after
dueling KYOGRE.

SPECIES_RAYQUAZA.name: RAYQUAZA
description: It has lived for hundreds of millions of
years in the ozone layer. Its flying form
looks like a meteor.

SPECIES_LATIAS.name: LATIAS
description: It can telepathically communicate with
people. It changes its appearance using
its down that refracts light.

SPECIES_LATIOS.name: LATIOS
description: It has a docile temperament and dislikes
fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can
fly faster than a jet plane.

SPECIES_JIRACHI.name: JIRACHI
description: It is said to make any wish come true.
It is awake for only seven days out of
a thousand years.

SPECIES_DEOXYS.name: DEOXYS
description: This DEOXYS has transformed into its
aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by
altering its appearance.

SPECIES_CHIMECHO.name: CHIMECHO
description: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly
uses its long tail to pluck nuts and
berries, which it loves to eat.
